package normalization_adapter

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func TestCorpus(t *testing.T) {
	normalizer, err := New()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile("cases.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var cases []struct {
		Branch, Input, Mode string
		Value               json.RawMessage
		Errors              Refused
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for index, entry := range cases {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(index), func(t *testing.T) {
			input := []byte(entry.Input)
			before := bytes.Clone(input)
			var result json.RawMessage
			var err error
			if entry.Mode == "base64" {
				result, err = normalizer.NormalizeBase64JSON(entry.Branch, entry.Input)
			} else {
				result, err = normalizer.Normalize(entry.Branch, input)
			}
			if entry.Errors != nil {
				var refused Refused
				if !errors.As(err, &refused) || !reflect.DeepEqual(refused, entry.Errors) {
					t.Fatalf("got %s %v; want %#v", result, err, entry.Errors)
				}
				if result != nil {
					t.Fatal("partial output")
				}
			} else {
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				got, err := parseInput(result, nil, nil)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				want, err := parseInput(entry.Value, nil, nil)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
					t.Fatalf("got %s; want %s", result, entry.Value)
				}
			}
			if !bytes.Equal(input, before) {
				t.Fatal("input changed")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestInvalidUTF8AndComposition(t *testing.T) {
	normalizer, err := New()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, input := range [][]byte{{'"', 0xff, '"'}, append([]byte(`{"payload":"`), 0xff, '"', '}')} {
		branch, at := "root", "/input"
		if input[0] == '{' {
			branch, at = "record", "/input/payload"
		}
		result, err := normalizer.Normalize(branch, input)
		var refused Refused
		want := Refused{{Pointer: at, Rule: "input_syntax", Detail: "captured JSON token contains invalid Unicode"}}
		if result != nil || !errors.As(err, &refused) || !reflect.DeepEqual(refused, want) {
			t.Fatalf("%s %v", result, err)
		}
	}
	outer, err := normalizer.Normalize("root", []byte(`{"payload": {"n":1e999,"n":2}}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var encoded string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(outer, &encoded); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	inner, err := normalizer.NormalizeBase64JSON("record", encoded)
	if err != nil || string(inner) != `{"payload":"eyJuIjoxZTk5OSwibiI6Mn0="}` {
		t.Fatalf("%s %v", inner, err)
	}
}
